item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang ba thugs kyi sgrub pa sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud mchog dri med g.ya' bral shel dkar phreng ba
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan bde chen gling pa rtsal gyis sa pho rta yi lo la yongs rdzogs dpal gyi phug nas rigs mthun grogs dang rol mo'i bye brag bsreng ste gter du spyan drangs so slar yang sa mo lug gi lo la g.yu mtsho drag po mdangs ldan du dngos gzhi brda ris bod yig tu bsgyur//
